sections.title: Parent-Teacher Conferences
sections.text: Sign up for a 15-minute conference with your child’s teacher on Monday, November 16, between 9:00 AM and 1:00 PM. Families in 7th through 12th grade meet with all three high school teachers together.

sections.title: Calendars
sections.text: Our school calendar is designed to balance academic rigor with well-deserved breaks, providing students and educators with optimal learning opportunities.

sections.title: Report Student Absence
sections.text: Advance notice of your student’s absence for appointments, family events, illness, etc. helps teachers prepare and keep students on track. Fill out the form below; the school office and your child’s homeroom teacher will be told, and you’ll get a confirmation email.

sections.title: Recommend a Family
sections.text: Do you know a family who would love Independent Baptist Academy? We would be glad to hear about them. Tell us a little about the student, and leave your own contact information so we can follow up with you if we have questions. Thank you for helping our school family grow!

questions.label: How do you know this family?
questions.help: For example: neighbor, church, co-worker, sports team.

questions.label: The student is respectful to adults.
The student gets along well with other children.
The student works hard in school.
The student follows rules and instructions.
The student would be a good influence on classmates.
The student's family values a Christian education.
Tell us about the student's family.
questions.help: For example: parents, brothers and sisters, church, what matters to them.

questions.label: How would you describe the student's character?
questions.help: For example: kind, respectful, a hard worker, a leader.

questions.label: What are the student's interests or strengths?
questions.help: Sports, music, art, reading, math, etc.

questions.label: Why do you think IBA would be a good fit for this student?
Anything else we should know?
questions.help: Interests, sports, siblings, special needs, timing, etc.

sections.title: Feedback for Administration
sections.text: We value good communication between parents and the school as we work together for our students. Use this form to share a question, concern, suggestion or word of thanks with the administration.

sections.title: Gradelink
sections.text:
Gradelink makes it simple to maintain parent and school communication. The parent portal provides access to academic progress, making it easy to view class and assignment grades, due dates, upcoming homework, and more.

Parents and students can download file attachments posted by the teacher, including worksheets, permission slips, study guides, and the class syllabus.
